Metadata.description: Sales CRM and inventory for TopStock Wholesale.

Import.title: Import leads
Import.subtitle: Bring in leads from a CSV file. Nothing changes in your CRM until you confirm, and you can undo an import.

errors.incomplete: Some rows didn’t arrive. Check the file again.
errors.not_staged: This import isn’t taking rows any more. Start a new one.

errors.bad_transition: That step isn’t possible for this import.
errors.busy: Another import or undo is running. Try again when it has finished.
errors.invalid: Something in the request wasn’t right. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.not_found: This import no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.timeout: The database took too long. Try again: nothing was added twice.
errors.unavailable: Connection lost. Nothing was added twice. Try again.
errors.discard_failed: We couldn’t discard this import. Try again.

choose.excelHint: From Excel: File > Save a copy > CSV UTF-8.
choose.safe: Nothing changes in your CRM until you confirm the import.

errors.not_csv: This isn’t a CSV file. Save it as CSV UTF-8 and choose it again.
